events.title: SJSU Art Galleries Tuesday Night Lecture: Elena Manferdini - Inside the Dream Factory

cases.refreshed: Hear Elena Manferdini speak in Inside the Dream Factory, part of the SJSU Art Galleries weekly lecture series with visiting artists and designers.
cases.reviewed: Hear Elena Manferdini give her talk "Inside the Dream Factory" as part of the weekly SJSU Art Galleries lecture series with visiting artists and designers.

cases.refreshed: Join us for casual in-gallery conversations in our special exhibition, Jane!, facilitated by our Museum Engagement Guides.
cases.reviewed: Museum Engagement Guides lead casual conversations in the "JANE!" exhibition.

cases.refreshed: Tour Cantor Arts Center's galleries on a guided "A Closer Look" walk that points out new details and connections in the art.
cases.reviewed: Take a guided tour of the Cantor Arts Center galleries to discover new details and connections among selected works.

cases.refreshed: We welcome volunteers 10 years old and older. Those between 10 and 14 years old are required to have a guardian actively volunteering alongside them for the duration of the volunteer session. All volunteers must complete a safety waiver on arrival.
cases.reviewed: Volunteers must be at least 10 years old. A guardian must volunteer alongside each participant aged 10 to 14 for the full session. All volunteers must complete a safety waiver on arrival.

cases.refreshed: Walk through the indoor and outdoor galleries to see Rodin's sculptures with a guide.
cases.reviewed: See Rodin's work in the galleries and sculpture garden on a guided tour of Cantor Arts Center.
